attributes.action: Mandate GPS location, time details and photo for all parcel delivery companies
attributes.additional_details:
Every day, thousands of consumers experience parcels being delivered to the wrong address. Courier companies often provide a photograph as proof of delivery, but this frequently fails to identify where the parcel has been left. We call on the UK Government to introduce legislation requiring :
• The GPS location at point of delivery
• The time of delivery
• The estimated accuracy of the recorded location
• A map showing the recorded delivery location alongside the delivery photograph
attributes.background: Mandate that all parcel delivery companies provide recipients with GPS location recorded at delivery, time, estimated GPS accuracy & a map showing the delivery location alongside the proof-of-delivery photo. This should only be available to the intended recipient and comply with UK data protection.
